systems.system: Ghana Card registration of children aged 6 to 14
systems.owner: National Identification Authority (NIA), with the National Health Insurance Authority
systems.tiers: registration machines deployed to schools in the Volta and Oti Regions from 5 May 2026, about 21 days, then the five northern regions and others

note: A school-based identity-card enrolment campaign; the birth certificate appears only as a supporting document.
